notes.title: Update 2.7: More rides & fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,  


today we present you the latest update 2.7.  

New rides
This update also includes two new rides! "Noise Machine" and "Power Dive" are now available. See for yourself: 
[previewyoutube="Kbsm20M830E;full"][/previewyoutube]

You can unlock the new rides here:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3463040/Virtual_Rides_3__Ride_Pack_3_Noise_Machine__Power_Dive/"][/dynamiclink]

As always, you often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition. [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/"][/dynamiclink]
Other Changes:
Improved: Background walls and lightbox signs are now slightly illuminated at night.

Fixed: The Chopper ride's damping was too aggressive when parking.

Fixed: An issue where restraints on the Chopper ride could be opened while upside down.

Fixed: Visitors no longer being pushed into the moving parts on certain rides.

Fixed: An issue preventing visitors from queuing up properly for the Astronaut ride.

Fixed: Missing Level of Detail (LOD) on the Haunted Spin ride.

Fixed: Effects are now controllable after switching design presets.

Fixed: Removed a duplicate dual-color option from the lighting menu and replaced it with a new combination.

Fixed: The Salsa ride's damping was too aggressive.

Fixed: A trailer clipped through a building on one map tile.

Fixed: The player's default starting position has been corrected.

Fixed: Several other minor issues have been resolved.



As always, we value your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts on this update with us. Your continued support helps us make VR3 better with every update. You can also join our Pixelsplit Discord server: https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA  


- Your Team Pixelsplit

notes.title: Update 2.6: New rides and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

today we present you the latest update 2.6.

New rides This update also includes two new rides (as with version 2.5)! "Continuum" and "Power Spin" are now available. See for yourself:

[previewyoutube=Eo-P8shwt5E;full][/previewyoutube]

You can unlock the new rides here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010360/Virtual_Rides_3__Ride_Pack_2_Power_Spin__Continuum/

As always, you often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition. https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

New: Save your light settings Added: Light settings can now be saved and automatically reactivate as soon as you enter the ride {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/ecc50fb27e05dd7412f662833fad49b2c453bb2d.gif

Improved speed sliders Improved: Speed sliders now show the "actual" value in the fill (instead of target value) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/a8424eb9343ef1f9a758a3f192ae4e38aac39b8f.gif

Bugfixes:  Fixed: Speed up / slow down time did not work with keyboard (now works with frame up / frame down keys) Fixed: Upside Down was missing a tank model at low detail settings Fixed: Glider On Ride camera was not centered Fixed: Truck clipping in Salsa ride Fixed: Visitors jittering when boarding in "Forge" Fixed: Sometimes visitors perform "Buy" interaction in center of square instead of in front of cashier/booth Fixed: Upside Down + Glider had issues in the VR Experience Fixed:  Glider one fence was offset in LOD1 Fixed: Giant Mill did not park properly when riding clockwise  

Evaluation of the big VR4 survey

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/f7bc465e241d675e9a7f4055b1851f566d4f8805.jpg
Disclaimer: VR4 is NOT CONFIRMED. We are still in the process of evaluating its feasibility.

We conducted a large survey under the motto “Shape The Future of Virtual Rides”. We received a lot of great submissions and were able to get a good overview of your wishes and ideas for a potential successor to Virtual Rides 3. We would like to take this opportunity to give you a little insight into the results:

TOP 5 - the most requested new features: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/8778c2920813740077d967c5f5650e2716c482cd.png

TOP 3 - the most popular game modes: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/f50e2460a4aed71fb2e77dde0ec9c164c05fb44f.png

TOP 3 - your individual wishes: 
[olist]
 Ride Customization
 Fairground Simulation
 Enhanced Audio Features
[/olist]
Regarding 1. above all, customizable light/LED effects and decoration were mentioned. In addition, (even) more realistic controls and storable, automatic ride programs.

For 2. the assembly and dismantling of rides, individual fairground layouts and a career mode were mentioned.

Under 3. you mainly asked for an improved music system with playlists, integration of streaming providers and more realistic ride and ambient sounds.

Create Your Ride
73% of respondents stated that they would like to use a “Create Your Ride” function, similar to Indoorlands. You can take a look at the workshop and see what users have already built there. Pretty impressive.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378890/Indoorlands/

Kickstarter
As the potential development of a successor to VR3 would involve a great deal of effort, both in terms of time and money, we naturally also have to think about funding. That's why we asked you about crowdfunding. Only a quarter of respondents had any experience of this, but 40% could definitely imagine such an approach and a further 46% could possibly imagine it. That makes us very happy!

What does this mean?
The results of the survey will help us to assess the feasibility. Thank you again for your participation. We would like to exchange ideas with you on our Discord in the near future. We would also like to give you our perspective on the project and the great challenge of addressing a larger target group than before with a potential successor to VR3. 
Until then, we hope you enjoy the latest update.

As always, we value your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts on this update with us. Your continued support helps us make VR3 better with every update. You can also join our Pixelsplit Discord server: https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA

-Your Team Pixelsplit

notes.title: Update 2.5: New rides and multiple designs
notes.notes:
Hi,

Today we unveil the exciting update 2.5.

New rides
This time we have focused on adding two new rides instead of one.

First up, we have "Glider" - Feel the rush as you soar through the sky. With its unpredictable twists, "Glider" promises an adrenaline-packed experience like no other.

Next, prepare to take a ride on "Upside Down" - Feel the G-forces. With its intense rotation, "Upside Down" is guaranteed to leave you breathless.

You can unlock the new rides here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790450

As always, remember that you can often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

Multiple designs per ride
We have also added a feature that allows you to create multiple ride designs per ride. You can then switch between different designs with just a few clicks.

These are also stored under Documents/VR3/Custom Designs. This means you can easily exchange them with other players.

We hope that this feature will also be of interest to the active modder community.

notes.title: Update 2.4: New ride and new textures
notes.notes:
Hi,

Today we unveil the exciting update 2.4 with a variety of enhancements and fixes to improve your gameplay experience. And … 

New ride
We added the “Northstar” ride to the funfairground. Feel the strong acceleration as you fly through the air at a height of 30 meters.

[previewyoutube=tLnWBcLZkQA;full]https://youtu.be/tLnWBcLZkQA[/previewyoutube]

You can activate the new ride here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594530?beta=0


As always, remember that you can often get a better deal with the Ultimate Edition.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

Enhanced graphics
We completely remade a lot of textures and materials to have higher quality and more details, especially on the rides.

[previewyoutube=u2aFM-luWDA;full][/previewyoutube]

Other changes

 Added: Keyboard shortcuts for toggling laser, movinghead and skybeams.
 Improved: Some slight performance improvements.
 Fixed: Some typos in German language
 Fixed: Spawn position when selecting Prism ride on map (so it is directly controllable)

What is next?
First and foremost, we are overjoyed by the vibrant enthusiasm and enduring passion that you, our valued players, continue to show for Virtual Rides. The creativity shown through modding and the countless hours many of you have dedicated to the game truly warms our hearts. A big thank you to each and every one of you!

Now to the burning question: what is on the horizon for VR3? As a compact but ambitious studio, we've been channelling our creative energies into two other exciting projects - Indoorlands and REVEIL. Admittedly, this has left us with limited resources to devote to Virtual Rides. However, we're eager to put some more focus back into VR3 and are outlining plans to release 2-3 updates each year. The updates will mainly include new rides, but we are also working on some features such as managing different customisations for your rides, allowing you to switch between different themes. This should be of particular interest to modders.

This rhythm is planned to be continued for as long as the technical framework of our nearly seven year old game allows. We are beginning to bump up against some of its inherent limitations, but our ambition to bring you exciting new content and improvements remains unwavering.

(Addendum 24.10.2023) Patch 2.4.1
We have patched a few things from the feedback we received.

 Added: Press CTRL + Q/A | W/S | E/D to set the slider of the corresponding element to 0
 Improved: Northstar - increased light range

As always, we value your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts on this update. Your continuous support helps us make VR3 better with each update. Feel free to join our Pixelsplit Discord server: https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA

-Your VR3 Team

notes.title: Update 2.1: New ride, color things and other improvements
notes.notes:
Hi,

today we publish the new update 2.1. At the end of these patch notes (at the very bottom) we have some more news for all ride fans, who not only love funfairs, but also amusement parks... ːsteamhappyː. The update contains the following changes:

New ride: Flipping Disc
We added the long-awaited new "Flipping Disc" ride via DLC.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/25bc46ace9b471789a296e929f85031c7579613e.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1427010

Like always you might get the DLC cheaper via the ultimate bundle:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10726/Virtual_Rides_3_Ultimate_Edition/

Strobe colors & hex colors
Many of you wished different colors for the strobe light, so we added a selection for it.
https://media.giphy.com/media/DOqNFLMgcbNHBkY2eA/source.gif

We also added a hex input field for color selection so it should be much easier to set the perfect colors.

https://media.giphy.com/media/a5ZZqvtmwMlEwE21T3/source.gif

Modding improvements
We added custom font modding support. In the modding folder (Documents/VR3) you can find "Custom Fonts" now. Throw in .ttf or .otf files and they'll be made accessible in the game. This feature is experimental for now, so please give us your feedback about it.

Additionally some of you players had plenty of custom themes in the game which could lead to memory problems (because all these themes were loaded). Now we just fully load the themes that are actually used by a fully loaded ride. If the ride is unloaded and no other ride uses the theme we unload the theme again.

Other changes

 Added: Setting to select from different microphones (under "Audio")
 Added: Setting to disable vomiting of visitors (under "Game")
 Improved: Camera bounds for free cam
 Improved: The additional logo support frame is hidden now when entering no logo text
 Improved: When strobe is active material based lights are also deactivated (like Hurricane gondola headlights)
 Improved: Increased Big spin arm acceleration a bit
 Improved: Flic Flac gondolas should be a bit more dampened now
 Fixed: Clicking map item multiple times would start loading loop
 Fixed: Cashbox were not correctly mapped with cashbox texture (important for custom themes)
 Fixed: Memory issue with custom themes
 Fixed: Fog going in weird directions
 Fixed: Big Spin automatically putting podest in safety position when arms are parked
 Fixed: Chopper gondola physics acting weird
 Fixed: Titan gondola physics acting weird
 Fixed: Casino swing backwall being transparent in lower model detail
 Fixed: Hurricane gondola decoration being hidden in lower model detail situations
 Fixed: Astronaut ride parking upside down
 Fixed: "The Falcon" gondola grid texture being invisible sometimes
 Fixed: "Giant Mill" engine not rotating correctly when controlled with panel
 Fixed: "Giant Mill" not parking correctly
 Fixed: Wrong flag order on "Handstand" ride
 Unity Engine Update 2019.4


We hope you like the update and are happy to receive your feedback. As always thanks to the whole community without you this would not be possible. Feel free to join our Pixelsplit Simulations Discord server: https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA

Indoorlands
Yesterday we published our page about our upcoming new game "Indoorlands". Please feel free to check it out and wishlist the game to stay up to date.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378890/Indoorlands

- Your VR3 Team

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Rides, sounds and confetti
notes.notes:
Hey,

today we're releasing the version 2.0 update. It contains the following improvements and extensions:

Two new rides:
The Update includes not only one, but two new rides.  And as a thank you to our loyal community, one ride is completely free.

'The Giant Mill'
This huge ride is available for everyone for free:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/d6e1166c95713e70a6699e2f4b44426a05b14850.jpg

'The Astronaut'
The second new ride brings you and your visitors an outer space experience. Get it as DLC and customize it with our new effect devices:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/4378f3bfd99f6956448251f52fea59e044abcc3e.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270000

New effect devices
We created and implemented 3 new effect devices that enhance the fun and the visual possibilities even further:[olist] The Co2 Jet
 The Confetti Shooter
 The Skybeam
[/olist]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/9808bda0780369f85c3ae20bae4119ef830e70aa.gif

Overworked sound implementation
We reworked the engine sounds and implemented more sound variations including wind noises and creaking noises.
Furthermore we're giving the player the opportunity to control the volume ratios for the rides, the jingles and the ambient sounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27454822/d31d35ad8398e115faafb97ab62573f43f0b4874.png

Engine upgrade
We upgraded the whole game engine. This will increase the performance for some users, but much more importantly, it gives us the possibility to work on - and improve - Virtual Rides 3 even more in the future. So the engine upgrade provides the basis for further long term improvements.  

Other changes
 Fixed: Krake cross engines would rotate strangely without being on

 Fixed: Big Spin restraints not colorable
 Fixed: Break sound on Handstand ride very loud
 Fixed: Cashier disappearing on Chopper ride
 Fixed: Crashing game with speed up and running

 Many more little bug fixes and optimizations

We want to say thanks to our loyal community and hope you enjoy the update we've been working on for quite a long time. We are always happy about feedback, screenshots and discussions on our Pixelsplit Simulations Discord Server. Here is the link: https://discord.gg/fDV3YPA

Ride on!

- Your VR3 team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065730/Virtual_Rides_3__Roundtrip/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/56cc31e2eb13fe44cceb3665ff2e0ec62367516b.jpg

Start of Modding Support - Custom themes
What you guys already did with VR3 is awesome! We are always speechless of the stuff we see in the screenshot section. Unfortunately we always break your mods when we release an update. We now started opening the game for modding! The first step is that you can load custom themes in your game.

Therefore just open the game and it will create a folder with the custom theming files in Users/Documents/VR3/Custom Themes/Custom Example. You can modify or duplicate this folder and change all the images inside.

- Your VR3 Team

notes.notes:
Hi,

first of all: Happy New Year 2019 to all of you! It is going to be great :)

Today we release update 1.3.5 to you. Here are the changes

Performance
The last patch introduced some performance problems on some systems due to the engine changes and how the UI was handled. We improved that and hope the performance is at least back at the old niveau. New settings
In the last patch we reduced the distance you can see and added a distance fog to blend out the distant geometry. Not all of you were happy about it so we added options for that (fog and distance).

 Improved: Reduced sound volume of “Rising Sun” engine crosses
 Improved: Increased the text size of “time” and “speed” in the time control panel
 Fixed: Freeze at “Crazy Spin”
 Fixed: Black screen on some systems
 Fixed: Moving head and laser random program selection missing
 Fixed: Duplicated color schemes for light change

- Your VR3 Team

notes.title: [Updated] Update 1.3 - New ride, new map tile and much more
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/9b1875c7844dac6b08820a558ceb7aa34097073a.jpg
Hi,

We know you waited so long for this (us too!) - today we release Update 1.3 to you.

At first
Please note that you will probably have to re-adjust your screen resolution, when starting the game. 

Furthermore it seems that the save location changed on some systems. 
C:/Users/YourUserName/AppData/LocalLow/Zeichenkraftwer Jeutter & Schaller/Virtual Rides 3 maybe changed to C:/Users/DeinBenutzerName/AppData/LocalLow/Zeichenkraftwer Jeutter _ Schaller/Virtual Rides 3. Just copy the folder "Virtual Rides 3" from the old folder to the new one (old with & and new with _ in the path).


New ride and new map tile
We extended the map (to the left of the current city tile) and added a new ride to it. We hope you enjoy it!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/00b6d184b044c4e77a2d90adf7da8d7ea3cf98f1.jpg

New customization parts
We also added some new customization parts, several of which are Christmas themed. But more importantly we added a new effect part. We present to you: The Flamethrower.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/5cfc471d31809a6c797885f586b8e6df9a2c5bf3.gif

Ride automatics (BETA)
To give the fairground a more lively feel we added automatic programs. These are started automatically when you enter a fairground tile. They are interrupted as soon as you take over the ride controls.

Please note that this is a beta feature, so it could have some bugs here and there. Also note that there is no automatic program for the Crazy Spin right now.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/fed0e3e93ea288fb920611f28046c509c4262441.gif

Other changes

 Upgraded to new engine version which allows future improvements
 Improved: Increased speed of animations in queue
 Improved: Increased microphone volume
 Improved: Performance (due to new engine upgrade)
 Improved: Running lights also have a color during daytime
 Fixed: Adjusted some of the navmeshs so visitors can walk more fluently
 Fixed: Visitors glitching in the lot booth
 Fixed: Graphic issues on some Mac devices


Future outlook
We are definitely not done here! In the next updates we will be working on:

 Customizable logos (font + color)
 Further performance optimizations
 Support for MP3s for your custom music
 More rides!


We are looking forward to your feedback and opinions. Feel free to use the STEAM Discussions. We also created a sub-forum for Bugs there. So if you have any bug reports, please post them there.

Have a nice Christmas!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27454822/e4f689b816ff498e73eb7afa9636cceebd2de50b.jpg

If you didn't know yet why it took us so long to create this update, read this: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/515260/announcements/detail/1706195930374952175

- Your VR3-Team

notes.title: New update: Release the Tentacle
notes.notes:
Hey community!

Today we present to you something very exciting – a new update with the title „Release the Tentacle“. Some of you might be able to guess what that means.

In the new version 1.2 we bring you the new ride called „The Tentacle“. A rotatable main engine, from which five tentacle-like arms emerge, which are moved up and down by the eccentric. On each arm is attached a controllable cross with five free-swinging gondolas (if the brake is not activated 😉). The ride is optically garnished with the flashing octopus head on the middle section.

http://zeichenkraftwerk.de/games/vr3/steam/update1_2/2-1_head.jpg

The very brave of you can of course experience the ride in „Virtual Reality“ – a the ride is of course also in "Virtual Reality" mobile – but maybe put a barf bag aside 😉

Besides the new ride, we fixed a few small bugs in this patch and worked slightly on the performance. 

Here is the Change-Log:

New content:
•	New ride: „The Tentacle“
•	Modified map tile for the new ride
•	VR Experience for „The Tentacle“

Improvements:
•	Visual improvements of the weather system
•	Several performance optimizations

Fixes:
•	Fixed sound problem for players that had a lot of jingles in their „custom jingles“ folder
•	The podest of the „Casino Swing“ ride lowers to the correct position now

We hope you like the new update. Enjoy it!
-	Your VR3-Development-Team

notes.title: Fly 'n‘ Ride Update
notes.notes:
Hey riders!

Today we deliver the latest version 1.1 which comes with some improvements, and above all with additional content, which we created for you – the community. Thanks for all the feedback and suggestions!
We present to you the new ride "Big Spin" - two independently controllable arm motors and a free-swinging gondola should give you even more exciting fairground thrills. You can even experience it in Virtual Reality 😉

http://www.zeichenkraftwerk.de/games/vr3/steam/update1_1/1-1_head2.jpg

This ride can be found on a new fairground tile, which seamlessly extends the already existing map.

http://www.zeichenkraftwerk.de/games/vr3/steam/update1_1/1-1_map.jpg

Furthermore, we added two highly requested features. We added a free cam to “fly” around a ride (you can control it with your mouse and the arrow keys on your keyboard) – this should give you even more ways to experience your rides. Many of you also requested that the control panel activation (Shift key) should be available from all ride-cameras, so we added this feature.
We hope you will enjoy this update as we do and are looking forward to hearing from you.

Here is the full changelog:

New content:

 New ride: Big Spin
 New fairground tile
 VR Experience for Big Spin and Casino Swing


New Features:

 Free Camera to fly around rides and finding the perfect camera angle


Improvements:

 Control panel camera can now be activated from any other camera on the current ride (in previous versions just the operator camera)
 Ride audio sources for jingles and music now have a reverb effect on them for more realistic sounds


Bug fixes:

 Fixed visitors queuing up in ride-internal queues, but never going to their seats (thus blocking the whole queue)
 Fixed visitors entering the "Titan" ride slowly
 Fixed visitors that left the ride after slowly advancing ride with restraints open
 Fixed sidebar tabs sometimes not closing properly (leaving a gap in the sidebar)


- Your VR3 Development Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi riders!

The next patch is finished.

Changelog:

     Feature: Auto-Talkover for microphone (like for jingles)
     Improved: Several performance optimizations
     Adjusted: Ride spawn points closer to rides, so they can be directly activated
     Adjusted: Several follower cameras
     Adjusted: Crazy Spin physics to allow easier rollovers
     Adjusted: Visitors now get pre pooled on initial load – thus increased initial loading time but better performance during runtime
     Fixed: motion blur not taking depth into account
     Fixed: Performance decrease when changing tile and adjusting time of day
     Fixed: Quite long loading times when not starting on tile 0
     Fixed: People vomiting when walking around
     Fixed: Sometimes walking visitors would be affected by gondola movements, that they are not on anymore
     Fixed: Chopper inner waiting queue did not work correctly (visitors just went away)
     Fixed: Sometimes on ride camera was inside a visitor
     Fixed: Stationary chip collectors (e.g. on Centrifuge) moved away over time
     Fixed: Camera on Hurricane sometimes was in customization parts
     Fixed: Non-stopping firework
     Fixed: Fixed people walking through red car
     Fixed: Glitch where people could unseat on the Casino Swing while engines running
     Fixed: Several bugs in visitor spawning system
     Fixed: Mouse not clamped in window when on fairground
     Fixed: Missing translation on “Control ride” tooltip on the top bar


Further fixes and features are in the making 😊

As always: If you have any feedback or if you find bugs, then just write us an email (contact@zeichenkraftwerk.de) or contact us on Facebook.

- Your VR3-Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we finished a first patch, which fixes many issues that you guys reported to us.We are happy about the hundreds of messages, comments and emails! Thank you for the all the great and constructive feedback, as well as all the praise and wishes (which of course we try to implement gradually). If there is one thing that we want to do better, then it is to develop the game continuously with you together! And that is exactly what we are going to do.

Of course, we have also read and heard your reviews regarding performance and bugs, and are already diligent in fixing these errors! But we still need your help, because we want to finally improve Virtual Rides 3 with you together! So keep writing to us, with bugs you've noticed and how you got them - best via Facebook or E-Mail.

Now here is the changelog for version 1.0.2:

     Fixed the many many redundant cameras on some rides (especially the Flying Swing) [this could also lead to crashes on the respective tile, so also for the Hurricane ride]
     Fixed strange physics on the Casino Swing ride
     Fixed issues with music player, especially crashes when only selecting one song + random song selection
     Fixed jingle UI breaking in certain situations (thus not showing second page)
     Fixed bug where shopping cart would show zero as a sum constantly, even with new parts activated
     Fixed pressing spacebar activating last UI element
     Fixed that settings screen would not open in main menu on OSX + Linux
     Fixed people don't stop vomiting in certain situations
     Fixed error log spamming (decreasing performance on some PCs)
     Adjusted follower cameras, to offer greater variety (+ less signs in the viewport)
     Added keyboard controls for microphone (- and , Key currently [- is with echo])
     Reduced the frequency of the bottle opening ambient sound


We know that this is just a part of all reported issues, but it should fix some major issues. We’ll now starts working on the next patch.

Important: Many of you complained about performance, we are aware of that. In order to improve this in all cases, we still need some time. But we know that there is one present bug: The loading screen disappears while still loading, so often it is loading without showing the loading screen. If you notice lag in these situations (e.g. teleporting to another ride or walking to another tile), then it is still loading and not a performance problem - please don’t mix these things up. Furthermore we’d appreciate when you would try to adjusting the graphic settings, until it works best on your machine. Probably we’ll add an auto-benchmarker, which automatically detects the best settings for your hardware.

- Your VR3 Dev Team
